description: This file defines a report parser class for generating analytic account balance reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for retrieving account data, calculating sums, and executing SQL queries for report generation.

classes.name: account_analytic_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for generating analytic account balance reports, including methods for data retrieval, calculations, and SQL query execution.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context and internal data structures.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child analytic accounts and their data, filtering based on balance and inclusion settings.

methods.name: _get_objects
methods.description: Returns the collected account data objects, triggering data retrieval if necessary.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches analytic line data for a given account and date range, returning formatted results with debit and credit calculations.

methods.name: _move_sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of amounts (debit, credit, or quantity) for an account and date range, including child accounts.

methods.name: _move_sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (debit minus credit) for an account over a date range.

methods.name: _sum_all
methods.description: Aggregates sums over multiple accounts for a specified date range and type (debit, credit, quantity).

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates the overall balance (debit minus credit) for a list of accounts over a date range.
